# antigravity-priority v1.2.18

## Release Notes

- **Accurate probe outcome reporting & display de-duplication in management**:
  - Refines execution feedback pipelines for single-credential and batch probe actions, faithfully reporting real underlying probe outcomes and precise failure reasons to eliminate state contradictions where failed probes could intermittently be displayed as ready or successful.
  - Improves overview card rendering logic to distinctly display failure badges and explicit error diagnostics for failed accounts, preventing semantic confusion with standard soft demotion or 429 cooldown states.
  - Completes light/dark theme visual styling for probe failure states, enhancing diagnostic clarity and operational confidence during troubleshooting.
- **Enhanced release checklist & history audit**:
  - Enforces strict git history tracing guidelines within the release checklist, ensuring complete, transparent tracking across all intermediate commits.
